firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Considering many of us are also doing the second track, if we include our code, or notebook to the paper, it will become public a month before the second competition ends. 

This feels like we have to choose between competing in one or the other. 

Is it possible to link the notebook but keep it private until the end of the second competition ? or give access to the judges without making it public, at least until both competitions end ? 

Even the papers being public when the other competition isn't done, and still has a whole month going seems a bit of a dilemna.
